evidence.applied_guidance_or_primary_claim: Repository explicitly describes partial book coverage. No whole-book validation is claimed.

evidence.bounded_excerpt: Safe reclamation is a separate requirement
evidence.applied_guidance_or_primary_claim: Reference counts or pointer tags alone do not establish safe reclamation; stalled participants can retain memory.

evidence.bounded_excerpt: A larger application buffer does not automatically increase the congestion window.
evidence.applied_guidance_or_primary_claim: BDP and window bounds need actual path, transport, and application assumptions.

evidence.bounded_excerpt: Limit both running work and waiting work.
evidence.applied_guidance_or_primary_claim: Bound admission by running and waiting resources; a semaphore alone can leave unbounded waiters.

evidence.bounded_excerpt: Each object has a unique name and a type
evidence.applied_guidance_or_primary_claim: Specify legal sequential operations before checking histories; this does not prove this design or its liveness.

evidence.bounded_excerpt: You should call dma_unmap_single() when the DMA activity is finished
evidence.applied_guidance_or_primary_claim: DMA completion must precede unmapping. CPU/NIC/GPU implementation contracts require additional API-specific verification.

evidence.bounded_excerpt: The Roofline model gives an upper bound to performance.
evidence.applied_guidance_or_primary_claim: Roofline is a bound and bottleneck model at a declared memory boundary using sustainable bandwidth; not an inference latency prediction.
